content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(ASM Exposed-Service Discovery Findings By Port) AND (BIOC(ASM EAL — Active-Scan Port Fan-Out Against Exposed Host) OR XQL(ASM EAL — Active-Scan Port Fan-Out (1 src to many ports on exposed host))) — raises a single exposure-management incident tying the discovered exposed services to the active scan that surfaced them.
rules.name: Exposure Management — Internet-Exposed Surface Discovered + Actively Scanned
